name: smells_like_a_bama_win
description:
Is your Saturday spirit sagging faster than a missed field goal against Auburn? Then you need our “Smells Like a Bama Win" candle - your new unofficial game day MVP and a great gift for any Alabama fan.

This isn’t just wax in a jar. Oh no. This baby’s packed with the kind of magic that turns nervous pacing into confident swagger. Made from 100% natural soy wax and scented with pure, unfiltered Crimson Tide glory, it smells like Saban-era dominance, fourth-quarter comebacks, and just a hint of “Bless your heart, y’all tried.”

Whether you're riding high after a W or trying to candle-cure a heartbreak loss, this little flame brings the W energy straight to your living room. Perfect for tailgates, tense living rooms, or just casually reminding everyone that “It just means more” in the SEC - especially in Tuscaloosa.

Because let’s face it - even when we’re rebuilding, we’re still better than most.
Roll Tide, baby.
